sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: IEEE 802.1Qbv：閘門窗與可用載荷
related.titleEn: IEEE 802.1Qbv: gate windows and usable payload
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學鏈路延遲需5±0.1 µs；兩情境都通過才表明駐留補償正確，不能把總往返的一半當peer delay。 as_peer_delay.csv、四事件圖與駐留不變性測試 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 5 與變更 5 us、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。 附離線證據實驗：python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-195 --out ./comm-v28-195-evidence；輸出目錄必須尚不存在。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching link delay must be5±0.1 microseconds in both cases; half the total elapsed time is not peer delay. as_peer_delay.csv, four-event diagram and residence-invariance test Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 5 and changed 5 us, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them. Offline evidence lab: python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-195 --out ./comm-v28-195-evidence; the output directory must not already exist.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學每窗需求8000 bytes；20 µs保護通過、40 µs不足；仍需保留跨窗幀規則與同步誤差裕度。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching demand8000 bytes per window:20 microsecond guard passes and40 fails; retain frame-boundary rules and synchronization margin.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成發送到收到回覆40 µs，對端駐留30 µs；擾動駐留增到50 µs、總往返60 µs。 名義式 (40-30)/2 = 5 us；變更式 (60-50)/2 = 5 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 建立發出0、對端收到5、對端送出35、來源收到40的同速事件線；擾動只延後對端回覆，鏈路傳播應不變。

合成1 Gbit/s鏈路、100 µs窗、20 µs保護帶；保護帶擾動為40 µs，忽略其他已另列封包開銷。 名義式 (100-20)*1e-6*1e9/8 = 10000 bytes/cycle；變更式 (100-40)*1e-6*1e9/8 = 7500 bytes/cycle。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 把待發8000 bytes換成64 µs序列化時間，加保護帶分別84與104 µs，獨立檢查是否落於100 µs窗。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic elapsed request/response40 microseconds with30 residence; increase residence to50 and total elapsed to60. Nominal (40-30)/2 = 5 us; changed (60-50)/2 = 5 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Build same-rate events0,5,35,40; delay only the responder in the perturbation and confirm unchanged propagation.

Synthetic1 Gbit/s link,100 microsecond window and20 guard; increase guard to40, with other packet overhead accounted separately. Nominal (100-20)*1e-6*1e9/8 = 10000 bytes/cycle; changed (100-40)*1e-6*1e9/8 = 7500 bytes/cycle. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Convert an8000-byte job to64 microseconds serialization; adding guards gives84 and104, independently checking the100 microsecond window.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學每實例History容量32筆；0.2 s通過、0.5 s不足；多實例總資源與Reliability阻塞仍需另驗。

related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成發送到收到回覆40 µs，對端駐留30 µs；擾動駐留增到50 µs、總往返60 µs。 名義式 (40-30)/2 = 5 us；變更式 (60-50)/2 = 5 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 建立發出0、對端收到5、對端送出35、來源收到40的同速事件線；擾動只延後對端回覆，鏈路傳播應不變。

合成100 samples/s，停頓0.2 s；擾動0.5 s，每實例獨立計算，時間窗含起點不含終點。 名義式 ceil(100*0.2) = 20 samples/instance；變更式 ceil(100*0.5) = 50 samples/instance。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 明列0、0.01直到小於0.2或0.5的時戳並計數；若端點規則改變，須重新處理可能的一筆邊界樣本。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic elapsed request/response40 microseconds with30 residence; increase residence to50 and total elapsed to60. Nominal (40-30)/2 = 5 us; changed (60-50)/2 = 5 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Build same-rate events0,5,35,40; delay only the responder in the perturbation and confirm unchanged propagation.

Synthetic100 samples/s and pause0.2 s changed to0.5, counted per instance in a window including start and excluding end. Nominal ceil(100*0.2) = 20 samples/instance; changed ceil(100*0.5) = 50 samples/instance. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate timestamps0,0.01 up to but excluding0.2 or0.5; changed endpoint conventions require accounting for a possible boundary sample.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
